targets.diary_window_note: Ruled D-EU-16 on 2026-08-26, option (a): the diary year is the calendar year holding the majority of the survey's fieldwork. All three surveys put the majority in the SECOND calendar year, so the intuitive first-year default would have been wrong for every fold (FINDING EU-S2-03). Pinning the diary window does not by itself pin the fold: `status` becomes RULED_PINNED only when the six DR08 gates pass on the converted EPW.

gate5_exception.caveat: Bologna carries a documented gate-5 exception on February and October 2014. October GHI is 17.36 kWh/m2 (17.31%) below the PVGIS benchmark -- the largest single-month exception granted in this arc -- and the same deficit appears in 2013. No Bologna result may be quoted at monthly or seasonal resolution for August-November without restating this. Annual GHI is within 2.55%.
